markdown.markdown: GEMs is a collection of short, experiential activities built for developing biology and computational skills. ```{r load-libraries, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, echo = FALSE} library(tidyverse) library(DT) ``` ```{r make-data-frame, echo = FALSE} contents <- tibble(module = character(), length = character(), topics = character(), description = character(), classes = character()) contents <- contents %>% add_row(module = paste0('"All of Us: Understanding Ethics"'), length = "45 minutes", topics = "Ethics, Genomics", description = "This module uses the All of Us Data Browser to encourage critical thinking on ehtical concepts in human genomics", classes = NA) %>% # Fill in classes add_row(module = paste0('"Forensic Case Files: DNA Barcoding"'), length = "30 minutes", topics = "DNA Barcoding, Species Identification", description = "This activity explores forensic uses of DNA barcoding.", classes = NA) %>% # Fill in classes add_row(module = paste0('"Gut Check: AI and Genomic Literature"'), length = "45 minutes", topics = "AI, Ethics, Genomics", description = "This short activity focused on the critical approach scientists must use to evaluate the validity of information, including information provided by Large Language Model (LLM) chat sources.", classes = NA) # Fill in classes # Add lab-period modules contents <- contents %>% add_row(module = paste0('"Database Detectives: Exploring Public Genomic Databases"'), length = "2 hours", topics = "Curated Databases, Homologs and Orthologs, Model Organisms, Gene Ontology, Genome Assembly", description = "This activity guides students through using publicly-available genomics databases.", classes = NA) %>% # Fill in classes add_row(module = paste0('"DNA Barcoding: Forensic Investigators"'), length = "1.5 hours", topics = "DNA Barcoding, Curated Databases, Species Identification", description = "This activity explores forensic uses of DNA barcoding and DNA reference datasets.", classes = NA) %>% # Fill in classes add_row(module = "DNA Fingerprinting (coming soon!)", length = NA, topics = NA, description = NA, classes = NA) %>% # Fill in classes add_row(module = "Escape Room: All of Us Research Bench (coming soon!)", length = NA, topics = NA, description = NA, classes = NA) %>% # Fill in classes add_row(module = paste0('"Epigenetics Explorer: Differentiating Cell Types"'), length = "1 hour", topics = "Epigenetics", # Fill in additional topics description = "This activity teaches students to use the UCSC Genome Browser to explore differences in epigenetic signals across cell types.", classes = NA) %>% # Fill in classes add_row(module = paste0('"Family Markers: Using Multiply-Affected Families to Identify Risk Genes"'), length = "1.5 hours", topics = "Hardy-Weinberg, Drift, Natural Slection", description = "This activity teaches students to interpret pedigree information and use bioinformatics tools (R) to build pedigrees for tracking disease traits in families.", classes = NA) %>% # Fill in classes add_row(module = paste0('"Genomic Medicine: Polygenic Risk Score Calculation"'), length = "1.5 hours", topics = "PRS Calculation, Genetic Testing, Ancestry", description = "This activity will walk through how to use an online polygenic risk score (PRS) calculator, as well as how to interpret the outcome.", classes = "Introductory Biology, Biology for Non-Majors") %>% add_row(module = paste0('"Population Genetics: Fish Pond Simulator"'), length = "1.5 hours", topics = "Bipolar Disorder, Genetics, Pedigree", description = "This module uses the PopGen Fishbowl simulator to model natural selection and genetic drift, as well as explore whether populations are at Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium.", classes = "Introductory Biology, Evolution") # Add research modules contents <- contents %>% add_row(module = paste0('"Differential Expression and the Mouse Gut-Brain Axis"'), length = "1.5 hours", topics = "Differential Expression, Gut-brain Axis, Neurodevelopmental disorders, Neurodegenerative Disorders", description = "This module introduces students to differential expression analyses using the R programming language.", classes = NA) # Fill in classes # Add other modules contents <- contents %>% add_row(module = paste0('"Exam Physiology: Wearable Data and Stress"'), length = "2 hours", topics = "Correlation, Physiological Data, Stress-monitoring Devices", description = "This module introduces data analysis of physiology data.", classes = NA) # Fill in classes # Order modules contents <- contents %>% mutate(length_sort = case_when( str_detect(length, "minute") ~ readr::parse_number(length), str_detect(length, "hour") ~ 60 * readr::parse_number(length)), module_sort = str_extract(module, '(?<=">)[^<]+(?=)') %>% str_remove_all('^"|"$') %>% coalesce(module) %>% tolower) %>% arrange(length_sort, module_sort) # Make DataTable datatable(contents, rownames = FALSE, colnames = c("Module", "Estimated time", "Topics", "Description", "Classes suited for", "", ""), filter = "top", options = list(paging = FALSE, autoWidth = TRUE, columnDefs = list( list(orderData = 6, targets = 0), # Sort "module" by "module_sort" list(orderData = 5, targets = 1), # Sort "length" by "length_sort" list(visible = FALSE, targets = c(5, 6)))), # Hide "length_sort" and "module_sort" escape = FALSE) %>% formatStyle(columns = names(contents), fontSize = "85%") ```
